material.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.
material.learn: Both averages rising with price over them: the long trend points up.

material.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Apr 13 to May 27 (+106%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−13% to −24%), on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Jan 15 high in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−38%); a close over the wave-1 high (+27%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +27% in 15 sessions, then drifted for 16 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 12% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.

material.head: Strong uptrend (ADX 37)
material.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 37, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with buyers in control of the directional lines.
material.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.

against.head: A breakaway gap down
against.text: On Nov 3 it gapped down out of a tight range on 2.6x volume and has held (−5.1% at the open).
against.learn: A gap out of a range on heavy volume that holds: the start of a move.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: Resistance +2.5% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +2.5% above (0.9 ATR), where 16 levels (4 kinds) meet: the Jan 15 high, the average price paid since the Oct 5 low and the 50-week average: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the 200-week average, the May breakout level and the Oct 5 low, where 7 levels (2 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Next support −5.1% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −5.1% below (1.8 ATR): the Jan 5 low, the Dec 8, 2025 low and the Apr 28 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
